programme.desc: When Ginger gets a nasty tummy ache, the Pea-Rexes have to find a special soothing herb.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: When it’s Bingo’s turn to bring her kindergarten’s Bob Bilby puppet home and record their weekend in the scrapbook, the family resolve to put down their screens and show him a good time.

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: The Squirrels are out walking around in the rain with Duggee and notice a rainbow! But before they know it, it’s gone and the Squirrels are devastated. They decide to make their own rainbow and go off in search of all the colours from everything around them, including strawberries, carrots and bananas. Duggee shows the Squirrels what he has been working on too - a rainbow cake!

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: Do you know someone who is having a first day sometime soon? Everything will be OK!

programme.title: Let's Go for a Walk
programme.desc: Ranger Hamza and the Ramblers go on a special autumn walk that starts in the daytime and finishes in the dark, where they all get to drink hot chocolate. On the way, they discover where a beaver has been at work, play inside a tree, make shadows with their lanterns and even fly like bats!

programme.title: Our Family
programme.desc: Eden and Ava make their very own necklaces using colourful beads. Eden kindly makes one for her best friend and gives it to her as a surprise. Later, the sisters go rollerskating in the park. It’s Ava’s first time skating on her own, but luckily Eden has lots of good tips for her. Will Ava be able to keep up with her big sister and become a super skater?

programme.title: My World Kitchen
programme.desc: Mateo’s mum is from Chile and she has shown him how to make a special Chilean dish. Sopaipillas are made with sweet potato dough and served with a colourful pebre made from tomatoes, spring onions and coriander. Mateo decorates his table with lots of plants and colourful flowers. There are even a few alpacas and llamas joining the party! Mateo also shows off his dancing skills to his friends while wearing a traditional Chilean costume. Let’s hope all of Mateo’s friends like the taste of his food.

programme.title: Maddie's Do You Know?
programme.desc: In today's episode, Maddie is visiting a supermarket, where she finds out what barcodes are and how they work. At the checkout, we learn how an infrared scanner reads barcodes to find out what items we are buying and how much they cost. Maddie uses a special camera to see how the right items in the stock room get to the right shelves in the supermarket. Next, Maddie heads to a factory to see how fishcakes are made. We see how fresh cod is filleted and added to other ingredients on a massive scale. Maddie uses a special camera to show how the ingredients are shaped and go under a breadcrumb shower to come out as a fishcake.

programme.title: Dog Squad
programme.desc: Diesel is a hearing dog for his teenage owner, Rayane, who is deaf. This means he doesn’t hear everything. Diesel is trained to listen out for important sounds that Rayane might miss. Diesel is Rayane’s ears. Together, they’re unstoppable! Diesel wakes up wondering where he is. Then, he remembers – he’s on a camping trip with Rayane and his friends Grace and Karim. And Mum’s come too! Rayane’s even made a dreamcatcher from sticks and leaves he found around the campsite. But now it’s time to go home, so there’s lots they need to do. After a breakfast of boiled eggs and toast, Diesel helps Rayane brush his teeth. It’s Diesel’s job to filter out all the other sounds at the campsite and let Rayane know when the timer goes off to let him know he’s brushed for long enough. Then, while the humans pack up camp, making sure not to leave any litter behind, Diesel has to listen out for Dad’s text so they can all meet him at the car park. The campers excitedly carry their kit back to meet Dad. But Rayane has left his dreamcatcher behind! Can Diesel follow the trail of familiar sounds to help Rayane find the campsite again – and collect Rayane’s missing dreamcatcher?

programme.title: Go Wild
programme.desc: Aneeshwar and Lizzie meet two tapirs, Inca and Mani - a mother and her son. These incredible animals are almost like three animals in one, with a body resembling a pig, the feet of a rhino and the nose of an elephant. Next, they head into the dark to encounter another animal that loves fruit: the fruit bat, or flying fox. Hanging upside down, the flying foxes feed nearby, giving Aneeshwar and Lizzie the chance to meet these furry-faced bats. Finally, Aneeshwar and Lizzie discover the wild connection between these two remarkable animals.

programme.title: Waffle the Wonder Dog
programme.desc: The Brooklyn-Bells are on holiday with Gramps, so Waffle is staying at Angela’s dog kennels for a couple of nights. During a face-to-face call with Waffle, the Brooklyn-Bells check their wonder dog is settling in and ensure he has his favourite snuggly toy with him, PegStar. Angela tries to settle Waffle but he whines, he’s missing his Brooklyn-Bell family and looks at their photo on the wall of his kennel. Angela resorts to calling the Brooklyn-Bells and explains that when dogs are very disruptive, she expects their owners, or someone they know, to pick them up. Jess has an idea – there’s someone who might be able to pick Waffle up in the morning - Mrs Hobbs!

programme.title: Puffin Rock
programme.desc: Baba and Oona experience snow – for the very first time!

programme.title: Small Potatoes
programme.desc: Animated series about a group of singing potatoes. In this swinging homage to the Sinatra era, the Small Potatoes sing about how they are no average spuds.

programme.title: Yukee
programme.desc: Yukee and TapTap spend the night in a tent and are surprised to meet some beautiful, musical fireflies!

programme.title: Maddie + Triggs
programme.desc: While helping Mum sort through some of the postcards on the fridge, Maddie and Triggs imagine themselves travelling all over the world with their very cool uncle.

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: Norrie skips into the Clubhouse and greets her friends. Together, they reflect on their first meeting. Arriving with her parents in a long limousine, Norrie, her parents and her 72 siblings flood out of the car. It's just Norrie who is going to stay at the Clubhouse, though, and enjoy some well-needed quiet. She can play alone and hear herself think! But after a while, she misses the hustle and bustle, so Duggee introduces Norrie to Enid the cat. Together, they venture into the Clubhouse, and Norrie has a friend so she isn't alone, but she still has a little bit more room than she would have at home!

programme.title: Numberblocks
programme.desc: Four is the new block on the block and he can't wait to share how much he loves to be square! Learn all about the number four with Numberblock Four.

programme.title: Alphablocks
programme.desc: When Alphablock E opens his smoothie bar, he discovers that he has run out of fruit to make the drinks. He asks, 'who can help?'. A friendly parrot replies with a speech bubble: 'I CAN'. E learns to read this, and the parrot leads him into the forest. The parrot finds Alphablock O and Alphablock S - HE CAN and SHE CAN help. They give E oranges and strawberries, but he needs more fruit. The parrot leads him to a grove full of fruit trees. Who can help E pick the fruit? When more Alphablocks appear, E learns to read the final speech bubble: 'WE CAN'. Soon, he has smoothies for everyone.

programme.title: Something Special
programme.desc: It’s showtime! Justin and his friends put on a play, whilst Mr Tumble has a go at making a puppet theatre. But managing all his actors proves harder than he thought.

programme.title: Teletubbies
programme.desc: Tinky Winky, Dipsy, Laa-Laa and Po are trying very hard not to make any noise. Then they make as much noise as possible during the Tubby Phone Dance.

programme.title: Ranger Hamza's Eco Quest
programme.desc: Ranger Hamza and the Ramblers discover how sunflowers play an important role in the environment. They find out that they are made up of lots of tiny nectar-filled flowers, which attract pollinators like bees and butterflies. They also learn that they can be homes for insects like ladybirds, who protect them from other insects that like to munch on sunflowers. On the way, they enjoy some sunflower seed snacks and pretend to be sunflowers following the sun!

programme.title: Football Fantastics
programme.desc: It’s the Den’s summer fete, and Jaz is excited to do a chicken and egg mascot dance with her dad, but soon realises she’s double-booked herself and might not have time to do both.

programme.title: Grace's Amazing Machines
programme.desc: In this episode, Grace shows off three amazing machines that help with farming! Grace drives a massive compost turner, shows off a machine that makes hay bales and then picks some tasty carrots in a carrot harvester!

programme.title: Dodge's Pup School
programme.desc: It's pea crumble for lunch at Pup School, and when Biscuit gets peas stuck in her fur, Dodge mishears and thinks she has fleas. The misunderstanding sends the rest of the pups into a frenzy, thinking that fleas are spreading around the school. When Dodge takes a moment to double-check the facts, everything becomes clear.

programme.title: Our Family
programme.desc: Eden and Ava pretend to be superheroes and go on a mission to rescue their toy!

programme.title: Peter Rabbit
programme.desc: Animated series. When Mr McGregor fills a bird table with sunflower seeds, Squirrel Nutkin becomes dangerously obsessed with raiding it.

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: As Roly makes his usual noise in the Clubhouse, Duggee and the Squirrels reminisce about how completely different Roly was when he first arrived. Hiding behind his dad, Roly wasn't loud at all but impossibly quiet! As Duggee shows Roly around the Clubhouse, he squeals, hides and hangs off his dad, and just seems altogether too shy to fit in. Duggee has a great idea to introduce Roly to Norrie, thinking a friend will help him to settle in. But Roly is still too shy, so Duggee and Norrie start doing things with him, knowing this will help him to embrace the fun of the Clubhouse. While painting, playing with balloons and yelling, Roly begins to truly find his voice and be himself! Soon, Roly hardly noticed if his dad was around at all.

programme.title: Vida the Vet
programme.desc: Sunny is writing a book about his favourite vet, but first he needs to ask her questions. Vida lets Sunny tag along on a day of house calls, so she can tell him everything he wants to know – in song!

programme.title: Supertato
programme.desc: Chilli decides to become a superhero called Super Chilli! His superhero skills are put to the test when Evil Pea covers Supertato in sticky honey, but Chilli’s heat saves the day.

programme.title: The Weasy Family
programme.desc: The eagle family are performing synchronised flight. The ducklings are blown away and join the eagle family, who teach them how to fly in formation. Weasy feels left out and finds a way to fly 'for real' so that he can also take part.

programme.title: Mojo Swoptops
programme.desc: Preston is in costume as everyone’s favourite character, Dewey Dragon, but he isn't ready for how demanding Dewey’s fans are. Mojo and Bo need to help him escape the crowd.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: Bluey and Bingo enlist their giant invisible friend to show Mum and Dad who’s boss.

programme.title: Piripenguins
programme.desc: The shadow of a monster causes panic among the Piris, apart from Nugget, who is keen to investigate a new mystery. She finally tracks down the creature, but is all exactly as it seems?

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: In a game of hairdressers, Bingo has to find her voice, while Bluey has to find her ears.

programme.title: Balamory
programme.desc: Dr Ollie forgets who he asked to take the role of the wizard in his play! Ava’s memory-jogging machine helps him recall, but things get confusing at the nursery.

programme.title: Waffle the Wonder Dog
programme.desc: While Zoe helps Doug with his homework project about Alaska, Simon and Jess take Waffle and Evie to the shops to buy new school shoes. But Waffle's attempts to help end up causing chaos.

programme.title: Rafi the Wishing Wizard
programme.desc: Rafi is busy making a half birthday card for baby Oscar, but with ukulele practice, library reading and Teacup the dog to play with, she has a lot to do. She wishes for more versions of herself, and four colourful Rafis appear. Chaos ensues, until Dash encourages Rafi to take charge. She gets each Rafi to focus on one job - crafts, reading, music and play. At the café, the Rafis sing for Oscar, present the card, and then merge back into one.

programme.desc: When JoJo can’t find her favourite Captain Chloe storybook, Gran Gran suggests they make up their own story. As they create their pirate quest, JoJo learns that when you make up your own story, you get to decide what happens next.

programme.title: Sarah & Duck
programme.desc: Animation. Sarah and her best friend Duck embark on simple but exciting adventures, exploring the world both near and far in their own wobbly and imaginative way. Scarf Lady's jukebox inspires a knitted instrument band.

programme.title: Clangers
programme.desc: Nothing is going right for any of the Clangers today. Mother’s new plant is drooping, Tiny’s new tune doesn’t sound very good, Granny’s knitting colours clash, Major’s rocket has broken down and Small’s night light has run out of glow honey. But suddenly a wave of beautiful coloured light from a strange star passes over the planet and has a magical effect - everything changes for the better. All the Clangers are delighted until they notice that the star is fading away before their very eyes.

programme.title: BeddyByes
programme.desc: MeMo and BaBa chase a butterfly, and MeMo is gentle when it lands on their hand. At the Play Tree, they play with a bubble blower. MeMo blows a big bubble, but BaBa forgets to be gentle and pops it. The Yummies and MeMo teach BaBa to be gentle when petting Yummy Dog and handling some ripe strawberries. On the Lullaby Lake, BaBa is very gentle when the butterfly returns to settle on their hand.

programme.desc: In a magical forest, colourful characters have adventures and are read stories. Makka Pakka takes a ride on the Ninky Nonk. programme.title: How To Clean Up For Cash
programme.desc: Josie and the gang head to Glasgow to assist Caitlan in clearing out her grandmother Susan's lifetime of car boot finds. Over the years, Susan and her husband Dennis amassed countless items from car boot sales but since his passing three years ago, Susan's been left with a home full of belongings which has become overwhelming. Josie and the team face their most sensitive project to date as they have to secretly help Susan let go emotionally and physically, while respecting Dennis's memory. Josie discovers that Caitlan is a clutter culprit too, and as she was raised by Susan and Dennis since she was a baby, she also has an emotional connection to the clutter. Jacqui equips Caitlan with the tools to de-clutter, whilst Dan unearths some hidden treasures - from a Waltham skeleton watch to 22 carat rings. After shopping in Perth on the fake show, Susan returns home to discover her car boot finds all boxed up and valued. Is she ready to part with a lifetime of belongings and take the cash?

After shopping in Perth on the fake show, Susan returns home to discover her car boot finds all boxed up and valued. Is she ready to part with a lifetime of belongings and take the cash?

programme.title: The Neighbourhood
programme.desc: The secret Power House wastes no time to curry favour with a neighbour by gifting a lavish hamper. However, in the upcoming 'Neighbourhood Watch' immunity challenge, the question looms: will they prioritise their own gain or help out their neighbours? Strange things have been occurring on the close after dark, and for the next challenge the households will be on Neighbourhood Watch duty! Two members of each household, secretly chosen by the Power House, must stay up late observing all the Neighbourhood happenings. They must write what they see in their notebooks, and the following day Graham hosts The Neighbourhood Watch Quiz where their knowledge and attention to detail is tested - but there is a sting in the tale as the Power House also gets to disadvantage one household and take away their notebook! Who will they choose and will this decision come back to haunt them when Graham later reveals who the Power House is? Strategy takes centre stage as one household secures vital immunity.

programme.title: How To Clean Up For Cash
programme.desc: Josie and the gang head to Glasgow to assist Caitlan in clearing out her grandmother Susan's lifetime of car boot finds. Over the years, Susan and her husband Dennis amassed countless items from car boot sales but since his passing three years ago, Susan's been left with a home full of belongings which has become overwhelming. Josie and the team face their most sensitive project to date as they have to secretly help Susan let go emotionally and physically, while respecting Dennis's memory. Josie discovers that Caitlan is a clutter culprit too, and as she was raised by Susan and Dennis since she was a baby, she also has an emotional connection to the clutter. Jacqui equips Caitlan with the tools to de-clutter, whilst Dan unearths some hidden treasures - from a Waltham skeleton watch to 22 carat rings. After shopping in Perth on the fake show, Susan returns home to discover her car boot finds all boxed up and valued. Is she ready to part with a lifetime of belongings and take the cash?

programme.title: The Neighbourhood
programme.desc: The secret Power House wastes no time to curry favour with a neighbour by gifting a lavish hamper. However, in the upcoming 'Neighbourhood Watch' immunity challenge, the question looms: will they prioritise their own gain or help out their neighbours? Strange things have been occurring on the close after dark, and for the next challenge the households will be on Neighbourhood Watch duty! Two members of each household, secretly chosen by the Power House, must stay up late observing all the Neighbourhood happenings. They must write what they see in their notebooks, and the following day Graham hosts The Neighbourhood Watch Quiz where their knowledge and attention to detail is tested - but there is a sting in the tale as the Power House also gets to disadvantage one household and take away their notebook! Who will they choose and will this decision come back to haunt them when Graham later reveals who the Power House is? Strategy takes centre stage as one household secures vital immunity.

programme.title: How To Clean Up For Cash
programme.desc: Josie and the gang head to Glasgow to assist Caitlan in clearing out her grandmother Susan's lifetime of car boot finds. Over the years, Susan and her husband Dennis amassed countless items from car boot sales but since his passing three years ago, Susan's been left with a home full of belongings which has become overwhelming. Josie and the team face their most sensitive project to date as they have to secretly help Susan let go emotionally and physically, while respecting Dennis's memory. Josie discovers that Caitlan is a clutter culprit too, and as she was raised by Susan and Dennis since she was a baby, she also has an emotional connection to the clutter. Jacqui equips Caitlan with the tools to de-clutter, whilst Dan unearths some hidden treasures - from a Waltham skeleton watch to 22 carat rings. After shopping in Perth on the fake show, Susan returns home to discover her car boot finds all boxed up and valued. Is she ready to part with a lifetime of belongings and take the cash?

programme.desc: With an ageing population and complex family dynamics, elderly people can fall victim to economic abuse from both professional and family carers. So how widespread is the problem and what can vulnerable people do to protect themselves? Ruth Dodsworth reports.

programme.title: The Neighbourhood
programme.desc: The secret Power House wastes no time to curry favour with a neighbour by gifting a lavish hamper. However, in the upcoming 'Neighbourhood Watch' immunity challenge, the question looms: will they prioritise their own gain or help out their neighbours? Strange things have been occurring on the close after dark, and for the next challenge the households will be on Neighbourhood Watch duty! Two members of each household, secretly chosen by the Power House, must stay up late observing all the Neighbourhood happenings. They must write what they see in their notebooks, and the following day Graham hosts The Neighbourhood Watch Quiz where their knowledge and attention to detail is tested - but there is a sting in the tale as the Power House also gets to disadvantage one household and take away their notebook! Who will they choose and will this decision come back to haunt them when Graham later reveals who the Power House is? Strategy takes centre stage as one household secures vital immunity.

programme.title: How To Clean Up For Cash
programme.desc: Josie and the gang head to Glasgow to assist Caitlan in clearing out her grandmother Susan's lifetime of car boot finds. Over the years, Susan and her husband Dennis amassed countless items from car boot sales but since his passing three years ago, Susan's been left with a home full of belongings which has become overwhelming. Josie and the team face their most sensitive project to date as they have to secretly help Susan let go emotionally and physically, while respecting Dennis's memory. Josie discovers that Caitlan is a clutter culprit too, and as she was raised by Susan and Dennis since she was a baby, she also has an emotional connection to the clutter. Jacqui equips Caitlan with the tools to de-clutter, whilst Dan unearths some hidden treasures - from a Waltham skeleton watch to 22 carat rings. After shopping in Perth on the fake show, Susan returns home to discover her car boot finds all boxed up and valued. Is she ready to part with a lifetime of belongings and take the cash?

programme.desc: With an ageing population and complex family dynamics, elderly people can fall victim to economic abuse from both professional and family carers. So how widespread is the problem and what can vulnerable people do to protect themselves? Ruth Dodsworth reports.

programme.title: The Neighbourhood
programme.desc: The secret Power House wastes no time to curry favour with a neighbour by gifting a lavish hamper. However, in the upcoming 'Neighbourhood Watch' immunity challenge, the question looms: will they prioritise their own gain or help out their neighbours? Strange things have been occurring on the close after dark, and for the next challenge the households will be on Neighbourhood Watch duty! Two members of each household, secretly chosen by the Power House, must stay up late observing all the Neighbourhood happenings. They must write what they see in their notebooks, and the following day Graham hosts The Neighbourhood Watch Quiz where their knowledge and attention to detail is tested - but there is a sting in the tale as the Power House also gets to disadvantage one household and take away their notebook! Who will they choose and will this decision come back to haunt them when Graham later reveals who the Power House is? Strategy takes centre stage as one household secures vital immunity.

programme.title: How To Clean Up For Cash
programme.desc: Josie and the gang head to Glasgow to assist Caitlan in clearing out her grandmother Susan's lifetime of car boot finds. Over the years, Susan and her husband Dennis amassed countless items from car boot sales but since his passing three years ago, Susan's been left with a home full of belongings which has become overwhelming. Josie and the team face their most sensitive project to date as they have to secretly help Susan let go emotionally and physically, while respecting Dennis's memory. Josie discovers that Caitlan is a clutter culprit too, and as she was raised by Susan and Dennis since she was a baby, she also has an emotional connection to the clutter. Jacqui equips Caitlan with the tools to de-clutter, whilst Dan unearths some hidden treasures - from a Waltham skeleton watch to 22 carat rings. After shopping in Perth on the fake show, Susan returns home to discover her car boot finds all boxed up and valued. Is she ready to part with a lifetime of belongings and take the cash?

Two members of each household, secretly chosen by the Power House, must stay up late observing all the Neighbourhood happenings. They must write what they see in their notebooks, and the following day Graham hosts The Neighbourhood Watch Quiz where their knowledge and attention to detail is tested - but there is a sting in the tale as the Power House also gets to disadvantage one household and take away their notebook! Who will they choose and will this decision come back to haunt them when Graham later reveals who the Power House is? Strategy takes centre stage as one household secures vital immunity.

programme.title: How To Clean Up For Cash
programme.desc: Josie and the gang head to Glasgow to assist Caitlan in clearing out her grandmother Susan's lifetime of car boot finds. Over the years, Susan and her husband Dennis amassed countless items from car boot sales but since his passing three years ago, Susan's been left with a home full of belongings which has become overwhelming. Josie and the team face their most sensitive project to date as they have to secretly help Susan let go emotionally and physically, while respecting Dennis's memory. Josie discovers that Caitlan is a clutter culprit too, and as she was raised by Susan and Dennis since she was a baby, she also has an emotional connection to the clutter. Jacqui equips Caitlan with the tools to de-clutter, whilst Dan unearths some hidden treasures - from a Waltham skeleton watch to 22 carat rings. After shopping in Perth on the fake show, Susan returns home to discover her car boot finds all boxed up and valued. Is she ready to part with a lifetime of belongings and take the cash?
